verdict.rationale: Steel is explicitly open-source (steel-dev/steel-browser repo) and ships a pre-built combined API+UI Docker image, letting an AI-native user self-host the core product; community comments corroborate its open-source nature. Missing for 10: detailed self-host deployment/config docs (scaling, storage, auth setup) beyond the single Docker image mention, and no independent hands-on report of a successful self-hosted deployment.
